jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
**QA Tester**:
PENDULO Studios es una empresa pionera en el desarrollo de software de entretenimiento en España. Desde 1994 contando grandes historias, actualmente somos la empresa en activo más longeva de la industria española del videojuego.
Te integrarás en un estudio cuyo objetivo es desarrollar proyectos cada día más ambiciosos. Por eso buscamos a los mejores profesionales. Queremos que ayudes a fortalecer nuestro estudio aportando tu experiência, tus conocimientos y tu ilusión por formar parte del equipo de PENDULO Studios.
Buscamos responsable de QA para incorporarse a nuestra plantilla.
• *Minimum requirements**:

- Capacidad para elaborar un Test Plan adaptado a las necesidades del proyecto.
- Experiência en testing funcional.
- Capacidad para trabajar de forma fluida con el departamento de programación.
- Experiência trabajando con Mantis BT.
- Capacidad de organización y atención al detalle.
- Autonomía y capacidad de priorizar tareas.
• *Desired requirements**:

... Conocimiento de mecánicas de juego y diseño de níveles.
- Experiência en Compliance.
- Experiência trabajando en el género Acción-Aventura.
- Conocimiento de las diferentes fases de desarrollo de un videojuego.
- Conocimientos de Unity 3D y Unreal Engine.
- Buen nível de inglés.
• *Benefits**:

- Un proyecto de videojuego de alto nível con una IP conocida a nível mundial.
- Una estética cuidada y elegante desarrollada con las últimas tecnologías.
- Un ambiente de trabajo agradable en un estudio consolidado y de trayectoria contrastada.

La incorporación al puesto de trabajo sería inmediata. Salario a convenir según valía.

jobs_results.title: Senior Tester/QA (d/f/m)
jobs_results.company_name: TK ELEVATOR IBERICA HOLDING, SL UNIPERSONAL
jobs_results.description:
People are at the center of everything we do at TK Elevator – we work as one global team, watch out for each other’s safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to help us shape the future of TKE and our customers – are you ready for the challenge to combine the digital world with our leading hardware solutions?

With integrated cloud-based solutions such as our MAX platform, we embrace the full potential of digitalization, transforming ourselves into a digitally augmented company to make life easier, more efficient and more comfortable.

TK Elevator aims to be a leader in industrial IoT solutions, data enabled solutions software solutions that make our customers and users successful and happy. Jointly with leading technology companies as strategic partners, we have just released our first Digital Native Elevator EOX. We will continue this journey - to improve the lives of people everywhere, every day.

You will co-drive this journey with a... dynamic and growing team that uses leading technology and works in a truly global setup to solve challenging problems, develop new business solutions and digital products:
• Hands on colleague performing manual execution of functional testing, regression testing, smoke testing, exploratory testing and UAT as well as automated tests with the Dev Teams
• Perform software testing based on business timelines and sprint schedules
• Create test scripts, execute tests, and prepare and present reports and metrics to management and development partners
• Data Analysis (e.g. Databricks) to identify outliers in metrics/logs like connectivity, resource utilization, consumption, API calls or error rates
• Partner with Development teams to help reproduce and diagnose issues and to continuously improve our testing approach and setup
• Collaboration with the Quality Management Team to manage the software release process and prepare technical documentation
• Immerse yourself into the TKE B2B world, understand our Hardware and Software solutions and take an end-to-end view
• Be an advocate for our customers/users and make sure in a pragmatic/hands on way that the solutions work
• Be a team player, bringing development, business, process know how, design and other competencies together
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Engineering, SW development or alike
• Over 8 years of professional experience in software testing and quality assurance
• Proven expertise in unit tests, performance testing, load testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing
• Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices is a plus
• Hands-on experience with embedded devices (e.g. Linux) and remote access tools (e.g. SSH)
• Solid knowledge of testing tools and frameworks
• Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (e.g., Python, Java) for test automation
• Experience in working with DevTeams and Product Teams (PO, designer, devs) and with Microsoft Azure technology
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Target-group appropriate communication and collaboration skills & team player
• Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken
• Secure job and salary – permanent contract in a technically exciting, stable, and sustainable industry and an attractive compensation package
• Social benefits and an attractive work calendar.
• Teamwork & safety – an open, transparent, and value-oriented culture
• Individualized training plan from your very first day.
• TK Elevator is a company with an open, transparent culture that focuses on the people who make it up. At TKE you will receive frequent feedback, continuous training and space to contribute your ideas

jobs_results.title: Rmt QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
Descripción
• *Oferta de Empleo: QA Tester**:
• *Empresa**:
Zemsania es una empresa líder en el sector de tecnología y servicios digitales, comprometida con la excelencia y la innovación en cada uno de sus proyectos. Nos enfocamos en brindar soluciones efectivas y de calidad a nuestros clientes, lo que nos ha posicionado como una empresa de renombre en el mercado.
• *Descripción del puesto**:
En Zemsania estamos en la búsqueda de un QA Tester con al menos 2 años de experiência en el área. Este rol requiere de un profesional proactivo, detallista y con habilidades analíticas para desempeñarse con éxito en el equipo de QA de nuestra empresa.
• *Responsabilidades**:

- ** Planificación de pruebas**: Colaborar con el equipo de desarrollo y otros miembros del equipo de QA para desarrollar un plan de pruebas eficiente y efectivo que garantice la calidad del producto final.
- ** Diseño de casos de prueba**: Ser responsable de diseñar casos de prueba detallados que cubran todos los requisitos... del proyecto, asegurando la detección temprana de posibles defectos.
- ** Ejecución de pruebas**: Realizar pruebas exhaustivas para identificar y reportar posibles fallos o errores en el software, garantizando su correcto funcionamiento antes del lanzamiento.
- ** Análisis de resultados**: Analizar los resultados de las pruebas realizadas y colaborar con el equipo de desarrollo para identificar y corregir posibles defectos en el código.
- ** Documentación de procesos**: Mantener actualizada la documentación de los procesos de pruebas realizados, asegurando la trazabilidad y el seguimiento de los mismos.
• *Requisitos**:

- Licenciatura en Informática, Ingeniería en Sistemas o carrera afín.
- 2 años de experiência como QA Tester en proyectos de desarrollo de software.
- Conocimiento sólido de metodologías de pruebas y herramientas de automatización.
- Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y bajo presión.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y atención al detalle.
- Certificaciones en pruebas de software serán valoradas.
• *Beneficios**:

- ** Oportunidad de desarrollo profesional**: En Zemsania valoramos el crecimiento de nuestros colaboradores, por lo que ofrecemos oportunidades de capacitación y crecimiento dentro de la empresa.
- ** Ambiente de trabajo dinámico**: Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinario y colaborativo, donde podrás compartir conocimientos y experiências con profesionales de alto nível.
- ** Remuneración competitiva**: Ofrecemos un salario acorde a tu experiência y desempeño, además de beneficios adicionales

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs_results.description:
At ING we are looking for QA Automation Engineer

Your role and work environment:

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic QA Automation Engineer to join our Release Team of Engineering Platform Tribe.

The responsibility of this team is enforcing the release process, guaranteeing the feature(s) quality delivered to our customer while reducing our cycle time.

Your key responsibilities:

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will:
• Provide regular, detailed status report on project progress, including test cases executed, bugs discovered, and bugs fixed.
• Pushing the existing test strategy inside the company, through advocacy and leading by example.
• Develop test plans that approximate real-world environments and tools that assist in product validation.
• QA Engineers are also responsible for driving the development process toward quality-centric methodologies.

What are we looking for?

Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the... most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
• Good analytical and communication skills, ability to deliver technical information at all levels within the company.
• A team player working as a core member of a team.
• Close collaboration within and across the teams of the tribe.

As a QA engineer, you must have:
• QA methodologies (e.g. shift left, test levels, test types).
• Experience in defining and designing test plans for acceptance criteria.
• Ability to automate operational process. Scripting (Python, Bash)
• Basic knowledge of relational data bases
• Create, configure and support CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
• Write and perform automated tests (functional, system, regression, and integration tests)
• Experience with Git including branching/merging workflows
• Knowledge of RESTful APIs
• Experience working with Public Clouds (Azure, GCP or AWS)
• Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools.
• English oral and written communication skills (B2 or higher).

What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

jobs_results.title: Localization QA Tester (Russian)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO). Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, 31st Union, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment.

Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed... franchises such as NBA 2K, 2K PGA, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Quarry, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, Marvel’s Midnight Suns, WWE 2K, and XCOM.

At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We encourage ALL applicants to explore our global positions, even if they don’t meet every requirement for the role. If you're interested in the job and think you have what it takes to work at 2K, we encourage you to apply!

What We Need

We are looking for someone who can test video game titles on various consoles, PC’s and handhelds to ensure flawless game play by thoroughly checking the software for errors and entering them into the testing database. The Localization QA Tester reports to the Localization QA Lead and/or Associate Lead.

What You Will Do
• Find and report issues in the game, or through testing directly in the text database.
• Provide the correct translation, and where applicable fix directly via text database
• Provide context for foreign language defects
• Identify defects, follow test plans, and verify fixes
• Enter clear and concise bugs into bug tracking database
• Verify all printed materials related to software in test
• Work closely with other Localization QA team members

Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit
• Must be fluent, reading/writing, in Russian
• Must be able to communicate effectively in English, in both written and oral forms
• Technically proficient with PC’s, gaming consoles and related hardware
• Computer literacy, specifically with Windows, MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Google Suite and databases
• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills
• Reliable with the ability to work in a team environment
• Attention to detail
• Passion for video games
• Be a positive role model, in terms of both work performance and attitude

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor diploma or equivalent
• Experience as a Localization QA Tester and/or Translator is a plus
• Preferable 0-2 years of QA experience

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

#LI-Onsite
#LI-LF1
